name: Time Heroes
storyline:
The game takes place in the Timelands, a universe with one strange rule: it does not forget time. A minute lived there leaves a small bright trace behind, a TimeStar. Where no one stays, nothing new happens, and that quiet is called the Stillness. Time does not stop in the Stillness. Change does.

A Time Hero is someone who stays long enough for the Timelands to keep going. Every egg they crack ends a creature's long wait, every world they open is one more place change can reach, and every colony they hold is a place the Stillness cannot take. The player is that hero. Quantulon, Exulon and The Mind are names they meet along the way, and the game tells that story itself.
summary: Time Heroes is a free multiplayer idle pet-collecting game by Timelands that runs in a desktop web browser. You mine, hatch and evolve a collection of pets across ten worlds, then pool that progress into a player-run colony.
